title: fspure.overrides.json
description: Project-level purity overrides. Precedence: overrides > library embeds > foundational.

useFoundational.description: When false, foundational.pure.json is not used as the base set. Env FSPURE_DISABLE_FOUNDATIONAL=1 also disables it.

add.description: Full method names to treat as pure (unioned last).

remove.description: Full method names to strip from the composed pure set.
